now.title: Agatha All Along
now.text: In episode 4, Alice joins the coven and kills the demon that cursed her family, using her mother's song.

proposed.text: In episode 4, Alice kills the demon behind her family's curse, using her mother's version of the Ballad as a protection spell.

changes.evidence: Alice is recruited into the coven in episode 2 ('Teen ... recruit witches Lilia Calderu, Jen Kale, and Alice Wu-Gulliver'), not episode 4. Episode 4 is the trial where she kills the demon with Lorna's song. Only the joining clause is on the wrong episode.

now.title: WandaVision
now.text: In episode 7, Wanda gives birth to twins in Westview, and Billy finds he can hear other people's thoughts.

proposed.text: In episode 3, Wanda gives birth to twins, Billy and Tommy, in Westview.

changes.evidence: Geraldine helps Wanda deliver twins Billy and Tommy in episode 3 ('Now in Color'), not episode 7. Billy's telepathy first shows in episode 6, when he senses Vision coming apart (see the new record below).

proposed.title: WandaVision
proposed.text: In episode 6, Billy uses his telepathy to sense Vision coming apart at the edge of town and warns Wanda.

changes.evidence: Episode 6 summary: 'Vision tries to push through the static wall, but he begins to disintegrate. Billy senses this with his own telepathic powers and tells Wanda, who expands the hexagonal static wall.' This keeps the telepathy beat that the old k0 put on the wrong episode.

now.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
now.text: In episode 5, Ayo comes for Zemo, clashes with Bucky, and later takes Zemo to the Raft.

proposed.text: In episode 5, Bucky hands Zemo over to Ayo at the Sokovian memorial, and she takes him away to the Raft.

changes.evidence: Ayo coming for Zemo and clashing with Bucky (and John Walker) happens in episode 4, 'The Whole World Is Watching'. In episode 5, 'Truth', Bucky finds Zemo in Sokovia and hands him to the Dora Milaje, and Ayo says they will take him to the Raft.

proposed.title: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
proposed.text: In episode 4, Ayo gives Bucky eight hours with Zemo, then comes for him and clashes with John Walker and Bucky while Zemo escapes.

changes.evidence: Episode 4 summary: 'Ayo gives Barnes eight hours to use Zemo ... Ayo and the Dora Milaje come for Zemo, but Walker refuses to hand him over. In the ensuing fight ... Zemo escapes.' Fandom (citing TFaTWS104) has Ayo pushing Bucky back with the spear in that fight. These are the episode 4 events that the old k4 text put on episode 5.
